items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Freddie Jenkins, when I first saw Duke Ellington's band, I was very much impressed with Otto Hardwick Freddie Jenkins and Sonny... But I only looked at the drummers.

ctx.x: Well, Duke had a different sound, different feeling, and he had a different -- had a little trumpet player in there by the name of Freddie Jenkins. Chief Whetsel Wetzsel was playing first. Freddie Jenkins, when I first saw Duke Ellington's band, I was very much impressed with Otto Hardwick Freddie Jenkins and Sonny, Orville Howard, like that. But I only looked at the drummers. Freddie Jenkins used to walk across that stage and strut. He had two fingers off his hands, (scots) and he would strut across that stage,…
Where did you first hear Duke's band?
